rule: Keep the released analogue features, 180s window, distances, weights and .4 admission threshold. Sort by feature distance; admit only non-neutral examples with shortDiff<=1 whose 30s outcome intervals do not overlap any already-selected example. Require at least 3 selected; otherwise immediately use existing structural fallback. No additional history, clock reading or waiting timer.
limitations: Reserved time blocks share an already-inspected Forex day; they are not independent broker sessions.
No live trade, click latency, profit or broker OTC accuracy modeled.
No tuning of the rule after outcome inspection.
